name: Recital I
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text: whereas the EU has allocated EUR 43 million for new bilateral programmes between 2025 and 2027, focusing on support for democratic governance and digital transformation, inclusive digital and green growth, and the development of a smart and eco-friendly agri-food sector; whereas Uzbekistan also benefits from a number of regional EU programmes and investments under the European Fund for Sustainable Development (EFSD+), Global Gateway’s main financial tool;
